body.statement: For every fixed finite response skeleton over the supplied observed alphabets \(\Omega\), consistency of \(\Pi\) and every support entailment are decidable by finite possible-world relation enumeration. Every feasible single-model support stratum contains a rational independent-root model obtained by assigning uniform mass on each selected primitive root or table-row support; each primitive probability is stored as a separate reduced fraction with denominator at most the size of that support, and no common denominator is asserted.
body.justification: This separates genuine inconsistency from identification and supplies the finite support front end.
body.gap: Fraser proves possibilistic compatibility by possible worlds, but does not impose named functional nodes while retaining a causal query and an independent-root probabilistic realization.
body.consumer: A support-aware causal-analysis backend can reject contradictory structural-zero and functional declarations before attempting effect identification.
